# Pie Menu

> Pie Menu is a radial menu component for React. It is a shadcn/ui registry item. Items sit in a ring around the pointer. The user presses, drags toward an item, and releases.

Pie Menu needs React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4. Its only runtime dependency is `radix-ui`. Install it in a shadcn/ui project with `npx shadcn@latest add @jpmarques/pie-menu` (it is listed in the shadcn/ui registry directory), or with the full URL `npx shadcn@latest add https://piemenu.jpmarqu.es/r/pie-menu.json`. A menu has four parts: `PieMenu` (the root), `PieMenuTrigger` (the button that opens the menu), `PieMenuContent` (the ring), and `PieMenuItem` (one option, with an `onSelect` handler). Two optional parts are `PieMenuIndicator` and `PieMenuCenter`. Each item can also take `onHighlight`, which runs when the item becomes highlighted. Items can be added while the menu is open, and the ring re-flows. The menu has full keyboard support and uses the ARIA menu pattern. For a custom look, import the headless primitive from `@/lib/pie-menu/primitive` and write your own CSS against its data attributes and CSS variables. The license is MIT. The author is João P. Marques (https://jpmarqu.es).

## Docs

- [Full usage docs](https://piemenu.jpmarqu.es/llms-full.txt): Install, usage, parts and props, live items, interaction, keyboard, styling hooks, and headless use, as plain markdown.
- [Landing page](https://piemenu.jpmarqu.es/): A demo video, live demos (including a maximalist menu built on the headless primitive), and a step-by-step guide.
- [README](https://github.com/joaopmarques/pie-menu/blob/main/README.md): The reference for install, parts, props, interaction, and styling hooks.

## Source

- [Registry item](https://piemenu.jpmarqu.es/r/pie-menu.json): The shadcn/ui registry JSON that the shadcn CLI installs.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/joaopmarques/pie-menu): The source code, the demo, and the tests.
- [License](https://github.com/joaopmarques/pie-menu/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT.

## Optional

- [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com): The component system that the registry item plugs into.
